messages.zaicode.action.dispatchQueue.help: Start eligible Ready jobs up to the concurrency limit.
messages.zaicode.queue.concurrencyHelp: Running jobs / concurrency limit. At the limit, no new job starts until a slot frees.
messages.zaicode.inspector.title: Inspector
messages.zaicode.inspector.empty: Pick something: an agent on the left shows its setup; a task in the middle shows its status, result and session.
messages.zaicode.settings.productDescription: ZAICODE is an operator-oriented multi-agent workspace built on the upstream ZAICODE runtime.
messages.zaicode.settings.concurrencyDescription: Maximum jobs running per workspace. The limit is enforced by storage state, not UI state.
messages.zaicode.settings.templatesDescription: {count} agents defined. Templates are starting points; edit freely afterwards.
messages.zaicode.settings.manageHint: Manage agents, tasks, and the queue in the ZAICODE workspace (sidebar -> ZAICODE).
messages.zaicode.subtitle: Agent team: agents take tasks from the queue and each task runs as its own chat session
messages.zaicode.field.poolHint: Pools are 9router combos exposed by the SAIRoute provider (Settings → Models). Any other provider model works too.
messages.zaicode.pool.hint.saifren: Free — every pool model reachable from the internet
messages.zaicode.pool.none: No providers configured. Add the SAIRoute provider in Settings → Models.
messages.zaicode.pool.noRouter: No SAIRoute/9router provider found. Add one in Settings → Models to get the SAIFREN / SAIOPP pools.
messages.zaicode.route.directReady: Pool selected. Dispatch runs the task in a new session on this pool.
messages.zaicode.route.directNeedsSelection: Pick a model pool before dispatching tasks to this agent.
messages.zaicode.route.poolMissing: This pool is not on this machine yet: add SAIRoute in Settings → Models, or pick another pool with Edit.
messages.zaicode.icons.title: Icons
messages.zaicode.icons.hint: Every icon placeholder is a slot. Paste an image URL, a data: URI, or a short text/emoji to swap it live; empty restores the default.
messages.zaicode.help.what: ZAICODE is your agent team and sub-agent platoon. Agents do work -> task queue dispatches them -> results stream to sessions.
messages.zaicode.help.step1: 1. Agents & Modes (left): Hunter, Tester, Cleaner, Wikier, Translator and custom roles. Click a mode to activate it, then assign tasks in the queue to release the agent.
messages.zaicode.help.step2: 2. Queue (middle): New task -> describe the work -> pick an agent -> Add. With Autopilot on it starts by itself.
messages.zaicode.help.step3: 3. Details (right): click a task to see its status, error, result and open its chat session. Parallel N limits how many run at once.
messages.zaicode.help.pools: Pools: SAIRoute is your 9router provider. SAIFREN = free internet models, SAIOPP = paid deep-thinking models.

messages.zaicode.profiles.name: Name
messages.zaicode.palette.title: Wintage palette
messages.settings.subagents.description: Manage user-level subagent Markdown files consumed by ZAICODE Agent.
messages.settings.subagents.workspaceScopeUnsuppo: Workspace-level creation or editing is unsupported
messages.settings.subagents.addDescription: Fill in the subagent name, tools, and system prompt, then save to return to the list.
messages.settings.subagents.editDescription: Modify the subagent configuration, then save to return to the list.
messages.settings.subagents.userScopeDesktopOnly: User-level subagents are currently available on desktop only.
messages.settings.subagents.group.plugin.hint: Plugin profiles are loaded from enabled plugins; only the model and reasoning effort can be overridden here.
messages.settings.subagents.group.builtIn.hint: Built-in profiles are runtime defaults and cannot be edited here.
